summary: Round 2: fixes BIO-IDN-005-QA-01 (Seyi round 1, High - reviewer evidence commit 67f77e8). AC01's contact-data signal was absent: the round 1 submission treated NAME_AND_DATE_OF_BIRTH (identity/demographic attributes) as this story's entire answer to 'contact data', reasoning that PERSON (BIO-IDN-001) has no email/phone/address field. The review correctly rejected relabeling different data as satisfying an approved acceptance criterion. Fix: PersonContactPoint - a new aggregate owned entirely by BIO-IDN-005 (natural key (TenantId, PersonId), no canonical id minted), holding email/phone enrolment staff record specifically for duplicate-matching purposes - mirroring the exact precedent BIO-IDN-003 already set for 'institutional identifier' (a sibling aggregate linked by PersonId) rather than reopening the already-ACCEPTED, merged BIO-IDN-001. Applies the identical governance discipline as every aggregate in this project from the start (internal construction/repository, InternalsVisibleTo, dual-boundary revalidation) and the identical ADR-0003 Decision 7 audit-atomicity discipline (per-person lock, audit-before-commit, ExistsAsync verification, CancellationToken.None post-confirm) plus the same BIO-IDN-002-QA-01 existence-gateway check (PersonContactPointService.SetAsync proves the target person exists via the same IPersonAttributeGateway ScanForPersonAsync already uses, before a contact point is ever stored - no orphan/cross-tenant records). Email normalizes at write time (trim+lowercase); phone normalizes at comparison time (digits-only), a deliberate simplification not attempting international dialing-code reconciliation. DuplicateReviewService.ScanForPersonAsync reads IPersonContactPointRepository directly (no gateway/adapter needed - same-project aggregate, unlike the cross-story BIO-IDN-001/003 signals) and raises a new DuplicateSignalSource.ContactData signal on a shared non-blank normalized email or phone value. Reuses the existing DuplicateCandidateAuditEventBuilder/IDuplicateCandidateAuditSink (one unified audit trail, distinguished by AuditTarget.Type) rather than standing up parallel plumbing; email/phone are withheld from Detail unconditionally, identical posture to every other PII field in this codebase, so the builder still never needs to register a 'personal' classification rank. New PUT/GET /api/v1/persons/{personId}/contact-point endpoints, wired via BioIdn005Module (new Singleton repository/lock registry, new Scoped service).
notes: Verified end-to-end: dotnet build api/Biolog.Api clean (0 warnings/errors). 75/75 feature-local tests (49 original + 6 new scan-signal tests including a normalization-boundary proof for differently-formatted phone numbers, 10 new PersonContactPointService tests covering validation/CAS/existence-check/audit-privacy/audit-sink-outage, 5 new repository governance/reflection tests, 5 new contact-point endpoint pipeline tests). 7/7 new real-packaged-host tests for this round (77/77 total integration tests through the actual PersonContactPointService/endpoint wiring, proving the CONTACT_DATA signal and AC04's cross-tenant exclusion for contact data specifically, not only name/DOB; 160/160 unit tests unaffected). One pre-existing, confirmed non-deterministic ObservabilityTests flake (StringBuilder race in a shared log-capture buffer, unrelated to this change) encountered on one full-suite run - isolated rerun 9/9 clean, full-suite rerun 77/77 clean, matching the identical flake already documented in BIO-IDN-004's evidence. BIO-IDN-001 (70/70), BIO-IDN-002 (47/47), BIO-IDN-003 (55/55), BIO-IDN-004 (70/70) feature-local regressions unaffected. 72/72 offline structural checks (14 new QA-01 checks, all verified non-vacuous against the actual new code paths, not doc-comment prose). contract-freeze PASS (38 artifacts). traceability PASS (19 implemented stories). module-reference-direction PASS (no new cross-feature ProjectReference introduced). secret-scan clean. Full scripts/quality.sh (repo-wide gate, non---full mode, same convention every prior identity-wave story's evidence recorded): QUALITY: PASS, 0 failures - captured to a file and grepped for FAIL lines directly this round (not piped through `tail`), per the lesson recorded in round 1's own evidence.
